connections.title: Connection Profiles
connections.subtitle: Manage PostgreSQL connection profiles. The profile to work with is chosen explicitly from the top bar.

toast.defaultProtected: The default profile cannot be deleted. Make another profile the default first.

confirmDelete.title: Delete profile "{name}"?
confirmDelete.description: This cannot be undone. The profile and its saved connection details are permanently removed.

confirmDefault.title: Make "{name}" the default?
confirmDefault.description: The profile is marked as default in the list. The connection selected in this session does not change.

form.title: New Connection Profile
form.description: Enter the details for the PostgreSQL server. Creating a profile does not select it.
form.name: Profile Name *
form.passwordEnvHelp: Optional, used instead of a password. Must be a dedicated variable such as PROD_DB_PASSWORD; PGGUARDIAN_* and PGPASSWORD are not accepted.
form.passwordEnvInvalid: Enter a variable name such as PROD_DB_PASSWORD; PGGUARDIAN_* and PGPASSWORD are not accepted.
form.isDefaultHelp: Shown as the default in the list

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.hint: Create a PostgreSQL connection profile to get started.

roles.title: Roles and Privileges
roles.subtitle: Manage PostgreSQL roles, their attributes and privileges

confirmCreate.title: Create role "{name}"?
confirmCreate.description: The SQL below will be executed. Do you confirm?

confirmDelete.title: Delete role "{name}"?
confirmDelete.description: This cannot be undone. The role and its memberships are permanently removed.

form.title: Create New Role
form.description: Create a new role on the PostgreSQL server
form.name: Role Name *
form.loginHelp: This role can connect to the server

empty.title: No roles yet
empty.hint: Create a PostgreSQL role to get started.

notFound.title: Role "{name}" not found
notFound.hint: It may have been deleted, or it may not exist on the selected server.

attributes.name: Role Name
attributes.newPasswordPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current password
attributes.validUntilHelp: Leave empty to keep the current date.

grants.emptyHint: No privileges are assigned directly to this role. It may inherit them through memberships.

confirmGrant.title: Grant {privilege}?
confirmGrant.description: {privilege} on {type} {target} will be granted to role "{role}".

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke {privilege}?
confirmRevoke.description: {privilege} on {type} {target} will be revoked from role "{role}".

confirmAlter.title: Update attributes of "{name}"?
confirmAlter.description: The SQL below will be executed. Do you confirm?

confirmAddMember.title: Grant "{role}" membership to "{member}"?
confirmAddMember.description: "{member}" will become a member of "{role}" and inherit its privileges.

confirmRemoveMember.title: Remove member "{member}"?
confirmRemoveMember.description: "{member}" will no longer inherit the privileges of "{role}".

members.title: Members of This Role ({count})
members.dialogDescription: The role you choose will become a member of "{role}".
members.emptyHint: You can make other roles members of this role.

memberOf.title: Member Of ({count})
memberOf.emptyTitle: Not a member of any role
memberOf.emptyHint: "{role}" is not a member of another role.

toast.nothingToChange: You did not enter anything to change

users.deactivateDescription: The user cannot sign in and their open sessions are closed. The record is not deleted and can be reactivated later.
users.activeHelp: A user must be active to sign in.
